sql:
SELECT
  store
  , SUM(__net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
FROM (
  SELECT
    store_id AS store
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END AS __net_sales_cents
  FROM "data"."main"."orders_enriched" orders_enriched_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31'
) subq_5
GROUP BY
  store
